name: lemeng.business_collection.day
_note: lemeng.business_collection.day —— 营业收款报表-门店汇总 的单块子管线（由父管线 ctl.foreach 驱动，不单独调度）。
生成器：scripts/lemeng/gen-business-collection.mjs（勿手改；改列集改生成器再重跑）。
骨架克隆自 lemeng.branch_indicator.day.json，身份门与分块在父管线。
① 请求：POST nhsoft.report.ai.businesscollection.find，一天一窗（BIZDAY=BIZDAY），branch_nums 由父管线按 100 家切好传入。
② 网关闸（denv）：code != 0 即拒写；10001=单请求超 100 家，10003=名单含本凭据无权限的店号。
③ 截断闸（gtc/dtc）：result.total_count 必须等于 result.rows 长度——接口不分页，不等即被截断。
④ 逐门店左连接（n）：以请求里的门店清单为左表，源端没返回的门店 matched=false ⇒
整天全空由父级 gall/dall 裁决，单块空只写 1 行占位（branch_num=NULL）保证分块到齐判据成立。

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

properties.message: business_collection 网关非 0 code（{rows} 条）：chunk ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}/${ITER_ITEM_N_CHUNKS} bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}；10001=单请求超 100 家，10003=名单里有本凭据无权限的店号。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.total_count') AS BIGINT) AS total_count,
         CAST(json_array_length(json_extract(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.rows')) AS BIGINT) AS n_rows
  FROM read_text('/workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
) t
WHERE t.total_count IS DISTINCT FROM t.n_rows

properties.message: 网关自相矛盾：total_count 与返回行数不等（{rows} 条）——响应被截断，拒绝写湖。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

SELECT CAST(req.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(input.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(input.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(input.branch_region_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_region_num,
       CAST(input.branch_region_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_region_name,
       CAST(input.branch_type AS VARCHAR) AS branch_type,
       CAST(input.payment_receipt_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS payment_receipt_money,
       CAST(input.payment_receipt_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS payment_receipt_total_money,
       CAST(input.all_order_post_fee AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS all_order_post_fee,
       CAST(input.order_total_discount_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS order_total_discount_money,
       CAST(input.un_paid_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS un_paid_money,
       CAST(input.make_up_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS make_up_money,
       CAST(input.cash_system_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS cash_system_money,
       CAST(input.cash_difference_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS cash_difference_money,
       CAST(input.shift_table_actual_cash_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS shift_table_actual_cash_money,
       CAST(input.card_deposit_money AS VARCHAR) AS card_deposit_money,
       CAST(input.card_deposit_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS card_deposit_total_money,
       CAST(input.card_consume_self_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS card_consume_self_money,
       CAST(input.card_consume_present_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS card_consume_present_money,
       CAST(input.prepaid_card_money AS VARCHAR) AS prepaid_card_money,
       CAST(input.prepaid_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS prepaid_card_total_money,
       CAST(input.pick_up_card_money AS VARCHAR) AS pick_up_card_money,
       CAST(input.pick_up_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS pick_up_card_total_money,
       CAST(input.coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_amount,
       CAST(input.coupon_detail_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_detail_sale_money,
       CAST(input.order_coupon_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS order_coupon_total_money,
       CAST(input.other_inout_money AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_money,
       CAST(input.other_inout_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS other_inout_total_money,
       CAST(input.online_payment_receipt_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS online_payment_receipt_money,
       CAST(input.online_coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS online_coupon_amount,
       CAST(input.all_payment_type_moneys AS VARCHAR) AS all_payment_type_moneys,
       input.branch_num IS NOT NULL AS matched
FROM (SELECT CAST(j.value AS BIGINT) AS branch_num FROM json_each('${ITER_ITEM_BRANCH_NUMS_JSON}') j) req
LEFT JOIN input ON CAST(input.branch_num AS BIGINT) = req.branch_num

       CAST(prepaid_card_money AS VARCHAR) AS prepaid_card_money,
       CAST(prepaid_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS prepaid_card_total_money,
       CAST(pick_up_card_money AS VARCHAR) AS pick_up_card_money,
       CAST(pick_up_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS pick_up_card_total_money,
       CAST(coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_amount,
       CAST(coupon_detail_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_detail_sale_money,
       CAST(order_coupon_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS order_coupon_total_money,
       CAST(other_inout_money AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_money,
       CAST(other_inout_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS other_inout_total_money,
       CAST(online_payment_receipt_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS online_payment_receipt_money,
       CAST(online_coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS online_coupon_amount,
       CAST(all_payment_type_moneys AS VARCHAR) AS all_payment_type_moneys,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at,
       CAST((SELECT count(DISTINCT branch_num) FROM input WHERE matched) AS INTEGER) AS chunk_n_matched
FROM input
WHERE matched
UNION ALL
